entries.desc: Special effective-ownership cases remain unchanged: B-META finding updates, validate evidence writes, delivery_check_set actor handling, and memory commands keep their documented owner-gate behavior.

entries.desc: Foreign-owned story mutating commands still reject without stealing the lease, takeover rules remain explicit, and LATTICE_REVIEWER_READONLY=1 blocks non-readOnly commands before hooks or lease mutation.
